front/attack: Use case: precise-object-edit. Repair only sprite-sheet spacing in reference image 1. Keep all SIX poses, exact character identity and proportions, illustration and anatomy; do not redesign. Use same 1536x1024 transparent PNG canvas, equal invisible 3x2 grid, each cell 512x512. UNIFORMLY REDUCE every character AND its effects to about 65 percent of current size, placing each complete figure centered within its own cell; target max occupied width and height 340px. Keep ALL alpha strictly within local x=85..427 and y=90..442. Preserve six distinct animation frames in current order, consistent scale across all. The empty gutters must be very wide; absolutely no wing, crescent, limb or effect crossing x512,x1024,y512 or touching image edges. True transparent background. No text, borders, floor, shadow or other elements.
